captions_meta.li_hook:
The first two weeks of January are crowded with announcements that were all prepared in December.
If yours isn't ready yet, now is the time.
li_body: From mid-December, many newsrooms and comms teams run lean. Teams that finalise January releases before the break go into the new year with momentum instead of a backlog.
What you can do this week with VRITIMES:
li_points: Prepare and distribute your year-end results or January announcement with guaranteed media placement (count depends on plan).
Point the backlink to your launch or product page.
Use the distribution report to review results and plan Q1.
captions_meta.li_close: Current plans and pricing are on our official page.
